ai.literal: Family those born among except is not naturally uprightness and sense of shame and together.
ai.translation: Uprightness and a sense of shame do not occur naturally together except among those born into a noble family.
ai.modern: நல்ல குடியில் பிறந்தவர்களிடம் தவிர மற்றவர்களிடம் செப்பமும் நாணமும் இயற்கையாகவே ஒன்றாக அமைவதில்லை.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the inherent qualities of those born into a good family. The word 'இல்' here refers to a noble or good family, rather than just a physical house. The couplet states that two specific traits, 'செப்பம்' meaning uprightness or moral correctness, and 'நாண்' meaning a sense of shame or shrinking from wrongdoing, are found together naturally only among such people. While others might cultivate these traits, they do not possess them as an innate, combined nature.

ai.literal: Good conduct and, truthfulness and, sense of shame and, these all three, they will not slip from, in a noble family, those who are born.
ai.translation: Those born into a noble family will never fail in these three things: good conduct, truthfulness, and a sense of shame.
ai.modern: நல்ல குடியில் பிறந்தவர்கள் ஒழுக்கம், வாய்மை, நாணம் ஆகிய இந்த மூன்றிலிருந்தும் ஒருபோதும் தவற மாட்டார்கள்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the core traits of those who come from a noble lineage. The word 'kuṭi' here refers to a family of high character and standing. The author identifies three essential virtues: 'oḻukkam' (proper conduct), 'vāymai' (truthfulness), and 'nāṇ' (a healthy sense of shame or shrinking from wrongdoing). Those born into such families will never slip ('iḻukkār') from these three principles, maintaining them as their defining qualities.

ai.literal: Smile, giving, sweet words, not despising, all four, attributes they say, to a true family.
ai.translation: A cheerful smile, generosity, sweet words, and not despising others—these four, they say, are the attributes of a true noble family.
ai.modern: முகமலர்ச்சி, ஈகை, இனிய சொல், மற்றவரை இகழாதிருத்தல் ஆகிய நான்கும் உண்மையான நற்குடியில் பிறந்தவர்களின் இயல்புகள் என்று கூறுவர்.
ai.explanation: This couplet lists four essential qualities that characterize people born in a truly noble family. 'நகை' (smile) represents a cheerful and welcoming disposition. 'ஈகை' (giving) and 'இன்சொல்' (sweet words) show their generosity and kindness towards others. 'இகழாமை' (not despising) highlights their humility and respect for everyone. Together, these four traits are said to be the defining attributes ('வகை') of a genuine lineage ('வாய்மைக் குடி').

ai.literal: Stacked ten-millions even if obtained, those born in a lineage are without the doing of things that diminish.
ai.translation: Even if they were to gain wealth stacked in tens of millions, those born of a good lineage will not do things that diminish their honor.
ai.modern: கோடிக்கணக்கான செல்வத்தை அடுக்கிக் கொடுத்தாலும், நல்ல குடியில் பிறந்தவர்கள் தம் பெருமை குறையும்படியான இழிவான செயல்களைச் செய்ய மாட்டார்கள்.
ai.explanation: This couplet emphasizes the unshakeable integrity of those who come from a noble lineage. The phrase 'அடுக்கிய கோடி' (stacked ten millions) vividly represents unimaginable wealth offered as a temptation. Even if such immense riches are to be gained, people of good birth ('குடிப்பிறந்தார்') will never commit acts that diminish their honor ('குன்றுவ'). Their character is defined by the absolute refusal to do degrading deeds, showing that true nobility values honor far above material gain.

ai.literal: That which is given having fallen inward even at the time, an ancient family from good character separating completely is not.
ai.translation: Even when their wealth for giving diminishes, an ancient noble family will never depart from its good character.
ai.modern: பிறருக்குக் கொடுக்கும் அளவுக்கான செல்வம் குறைந்து வறுமை வந்த காலத்திலும், பழமையான குடிமக்கள் தம் நல்ல பண்புகளிலிருந்து விலக மாட்டார்கள்.
ai.explanation: This couplet explains the enduring nature of true nobility. The phrase 'வழங்குவது உள்வீழ்ந்த' refers to a state where the wealth available for giving to others has diminished, indicating poverty. Even in such difficult times, those born into an ancient, noble family will not abandon their inherent good qualities. Their character remains steadfast regardless of their financial situation.

To maintain this honor, they will never engage in 'calam', which means deceit or baseness in this context. Consequently, they will completely avoid actions that lack 'cālpu' or moral excellence.

ai.translation: The faults of those born in a noble lineage will be glaringly visible, standing out like the dark spots on the moon high in the sky.

ai.explanation: This couplet emphasizes that people from noble or respected backgrounds are held to a higher standard. Just as a dark spot is highly visible on the bright moon high in the sky, even a small fault in a person of high standing becomes glaringly obvious to everyone. The word 'உயர்ந்து' (being elevated) connects both the high position of the moon and the high social standing of the noble family, showing how prominence magnifies flaws.

ai.literal: In the ground the nature of what lay the sprout will show; will show in the lineage those born mouth's word.
ai.translation: Just as a sprout reveals the nature of the soil in which it grew, the words from their mouths reveal the lineage of those born into it.
ai.modern: ஒரு நிலத்தின் தன்மையை அதில் முளைக்கும் முளை காட்டும். அதுபோல, ஒரு குடியில் பிறந்தவர்களின் தன்மையை அவர்கள் வாயிலிருந்து வரும் சொற்கள் காட்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet uses a simple agricultural analogy to explain how speech reflects one's background. The sprout that emerges from the ground indicates the quality and nature of the soil beneath it. In the exact same way, the words that come out of a person's mouth reveal the nature of the family and lineage in which they were raised. The repetition of the word 'காட்டும்' (will show) emphasizes the certainty of this revelation. The word 'கால்' here takes the specific meaning of a sprout or shoot, fitting the botanical imagery perfectly.

ai.literal: Goodness if desiring, modesty possessing is needed; lineage if desiring, let desire to everyone humility.
ai.translation: If you desire goodness, you must possess a sense of shame; if you desire family greatness, you must seek humility toward all.
ai.modern: ஒருவன் தனக்கு நன்மையை விரும்பினால் பழிக்கு நாணும் பண்பை உடையவனாக இருக்க வேண்டும்; தன் குடியின் பெருமையை நிலைநிறுத்த விரும்பினால் எல்லாரிடமும் பணிவாக நடந்துகொள்ள வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet outlines the essential qualities needed for personal and familial greatness. If one desires 'நலம்' (personal goodness or virtue), they must possess 'நாண்' (a sense of shame that makes one shrink from evil). If one desires to uphold 'குலம்' (noble lineage or family honor), they must practice 'பணிவு' (humility). The phrase 'யார்க்கும் பணிவு' stresses that this humility should be extended to everyone, showing that true nobility is grounded in universal respect rather than pride.
